description: The Dependency Dashboard is off: nothing here uses dependencyDashboardApproval or a concurrency limit, so the issue only ever restated what the open PR list already showed.

packageRules.description: pnpm 11 rejects lockfile entries published within the last day (`minimumReleaseAge`), so an npm update raised sooner fails CI until it ages. Three days rather than one matches automerge's hold, so the two presets agree in either extend order.
